description: Read a person's own spaces and their source files, as their agent (OpenVibe.Actor) works on them (plan 2026-10-22 §Z stage Z1: Space's builder becomes a task of the person's one agent). GET /api/v1/spaces lists the person's spaces, GET /api/v1/spaces/:id reads one, GET /api/v1/spaces/:id/files reads its files, GET /api/v1/spaces/:id/files/:path reads one of them, GET /api/v1/spaces/:id/preview says where it can be seen. A first-party service names the person in X-OV-Subject; Space reads only that person's own spaces, and another person's space is the same 404 as one that does not exist.
